notes: REFIT v2 (verifier fix pass). Previs params are UNCHANGED from v1 (re-rendered with the current builder: pixel-identical frames, frame-difference max/median 1.52, no pop). Reason: the verifier's two major issues (rear wing too high/wide, grey skyline towers where the real sky is black) are builder geometry, not camera/car params; I checked every param lever and none can fix them: car_pos z (sinking the car 0.2 m would bury ~30% of the tyre height), car_pos x/y (the 120 random towers cover 77-95% of the upper half of the frame for every rig position y in -120..360, best case still ~77%; x is pinned by the lane lines), lens/camera (the body is already fit within 1-3% of frame width, trading it for the wing would break the wheels/bumper), car_yaw (rotates the whole car). The fix is therefore a builder request (see builder_requests and the ready-made patch S07_builder_requests.patch; the proposed-builder look is in S07_compare_proposed_builder.jpg). Minor items re-evaluated: (a) push-in: landmark width WFL->BR grows 717->757 px (+5.6%) in the real clip and ~+4.6% in the model with the current cam_to; a stronger push (cam_to -2.70,-4.40) was tried and fits the bumper/tail-lights worse (cost 1893 vs 1621), so kept; (b) rear wheel 2-3% right of real = grey-box wheelbase 2.78 m vs ~2.6 m real, not param-fixable, the LM fit already balances front/rear wheel (+6/+7 px) against bumper/tail-light; (c) lens kept at 30 mm (27-35 mm plausible, no discriminating evidence); (d) speed kept at 21 m/s (wheel-spin alias direction; gantry grows x1.5 vs real sign x1.28 because the nearest gantry is 75 m ahead; shifting the whole rig +84 m along the road, i.e. car_pos y=84 with all cam/look y +84, would make it ~x1.28 but the sign scroll is not otherwise measurable, so not applied). WITH the proposed builder patch (wing slab 1.26 x 0.40 m, top z 1.12; skyline 0) the grey-box wing top-left corner projects to (61%, 28.5%) vs real (62.5%, 29.4%), right end (81%, 32.6%) vs (80%, 33%), silhouette height ~45% vs real 44%, sky black like the real clip. PREVIOUS DESCRIPTION OF THE REAL CLIP AND THE FIT (v1, still valid): Real clip (window 0.80-1.97 s, previs frames 173-201): low chase shot of the pearl-white R32-style coupe on a wet, empty, multi-lane night highway. Camera ~0.6 m above the road, in the lane to the LEFT of the car, ~4.7 m behind / 2.8 m left of the car centre (~5.5 m away), pitch ~0, no roll, aimed so the image centre falls on the car's rear-left wheel arch / quarter panel. The car is seen from the rear-left three-quarter (about 32-35 deg off its axis): rear face + left flank, nose pointing away and to the left of frame. It spans x 24-82% of the frame width (centre ~53%), wing top ~29% and tyre bottoms ~73% of the height. Horizon (end of road / far lights) at ~51% height; the road / car-axis vanishing point is just off-screen left (x ~ -8%), a dashed lane mark runs from the lower-left toward it, a lane line crosses the lower-right, a small green gantry sign sits far left, sky is black. Camera motion over the window: very gentle chase push-in (car grows ~5-6% in width: front wheel drifts ~15 px left, bumper ~25 px right at 1280 px), horizon fixed, no visible roll or shake. Previs: car at the origin, yaw 0 (+Y), convoy speed 21 m/s; lens 30 mm (landmark + vanishing-point least-squares fit gave 27-29 mm, the front/rear wheel size ratio suggests up to 35-40 mm, so 30 is a compromise); camera (-2.83,-4.68,0.64) -> (-2.75,-4.50,0.63), i.e. a ~0.2 m push-in along the view axis, aimed at the rear-left quarter (-0.56,-1.39,0.66) -> (-0.45,-1.23,0.64). Fitted with Levenberg-Marquardt to hand-measured landmarks (both wheels, rear bumper corners, tail-lights, road vanishing point) at 0.8 / 1.4 / 2.0 s, then verified with 50% blends at 5 times: front wheel, bumper corners and tail-lights within 1-3% of the frame width (<= 30 px at 1280), car width within ~3%, vanishing point x = -96..-110 px vs -90..-113 real, horizon within 1% of the height, wheel-contact-line slope 0.26-0.27 vs 0.25 real, push-in ~5% vs 5.6% real; no discontinuity (frame-difference max/median 1.5). Remaining mismatches: the grey-box wing is much higher and further forward than the real GT-R wing (~70 px = 10% of frame height too high, left end ~120 px too far left); the previs rear wheel is ~20-30 px (2-3% of width) right of the real one (grey-box wheelbase 2.78 m vs ~2.6 m real) and the roofline is lower and boxier; the previs has tall grey skyline boxes behind the car where the real background is black sky (builder skyline); the convoy speed cannot be measured from the clip: the real roadside sign grows x1.28 over the window while the previs gantry grows ~x1.5 (a stationary sign would need ~14 m/s), speed 21 was kept so the 10-spoke wheels alias into a slow forward spin instead of a backwards wagon-wheel; lens stays uncertain between ~28 and ~35 mm.
